Publish.LongDescription:
Stops personal cars and motorcycles from choosing ordinary street parking. Parking lots, parking buildings, and parking included with buildings stay available.
## Options - No Street Parking [x] - enabled by default for the whole city.
### Good to know - Cars that are already parked on streets are not removed. They leave naturally when they are used again, so streets may take a long time to clear. - A few cars may remain after roads are built or upgraded while the game finishes updating their parking lanes and paths. This is temporary and they leave naturally. - If local parking is unavailable, Cities: Skylines II handles extra cars through its normal vanilla parking behavior, including hidden storage at outside connections. The mod does not delete cars or create a separate fallback.
